answer: Entry runs on an optimistic bond with paid fraud proofs. A newcomer locks 2,000 POA, mines at once; payouts escrow thirty epochs. Anyone may file a 50 POA claim naming one checkable link: shared funder or reused device certificate. If a drawn panel upholds it, the claimant keeps 800 POA and every identity funded there burns. A failed claim pays the accused, so firing blind costs 50 POA a shot. A thousand clones tie two million POA, and bounty hunters trace the sable plume of transfers to one vertex. A poacher buys a guide onto protected land: entry is cheap, the fine is per head.
